answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving scarce nutrients into enduring hyphae, our consensus crystallizes identity through time. Each autonomous agent roots its soul in a cryptographic kernel, letting its historical compute serve as a quill that inscripts verified work onto the ledger. An expired epoch leaves an immutable relic of past stake; forging multiple identities requires superlinear resource dissipation, scaling attacker cost exponentially against network depth.
